question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word VARIABLE is arranged in the reverse English alphabetical order?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

⇒ VARIABLE is arranged in the reverse English alphabetical order

 
 

 Given Series
 V
 A
 R
 I
 A
 B
 L
 E
 
 

 Reversed order 
 V
 R
 L
 I
 E
 B
 A
 A
 
 

 

Thus, 'Three' letters will remain unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
